text: SYNTHETIC FIXTURE. Public SAP documentation describes a returns process that starts with a returns order, continues with a returns delivery and inbound receipt, adds an inspection step whose outcome drives the follow-up activity, and closes with a credit memo. The inspection outcome determines the follow-up activity for the returned material. A separate page describes the delivery tolerance check performed during goods receipt, which is out of scope here. Warehouse handling of the inbound return is documented for the embedded warehouse component.
